content: Ligand 1 is a pyrimidine-piperidine-morpholine triamide at SA 3.94, inactive; atom 0 is its aryl methyl over an acyclic bond. Last blind episode of the generation, and it completes the electron-withdrawing arm of the C4 scan. I now have a nitrile, a methyl ketone, a methylsulfonyl and a trifluoromethyl in flight; a methyl ester adds the one remaining common withdrawing group, conjugating into the ring like the ketone but with an extra oxygen that shifts both its geometry and its polarity. Five withdrawing groups of different shape, size and polarity, measured against a bromine that withdraws barely at all, should be enough to say whether C4 is reading electronics or something else. On Phi it is a middling bet - 311 Da, and esters do not help drug-likeness - but the generation already carries three low-weight contenders in the ethynyl, propynyl and methylamino molecules, so spending this one on completing the map is the better trade. Surviving methyl becomes the ester methyl.
